osaka_ramen_goku_honten.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles; fried rice with sauces on the table.
osaka_ramen_goku_honten.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork-bone broth; back fat; chashu; egg on the char-rice.
osaka_ramen_goku_honten.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–22:00; closing days not fixed; hours may change (Tabelog). Buy tickets at the machine outside (September 2026). Cash or PayPay; no cards or e-money (Tabelog).
osaka_ramen_goku_honten.notes: [Ramen · light tonkotsu and egg-topped char-rice by Tennoji] A nine-seat, dimly lit counter about five minutes from Tennoji, known for its char-rice: fried rice under a fluffy omelet, seasoned lightly on purpose so you finish it with the garlic or wasabi sauces on the table. The tonkotsu comes white, black (with black garlic oil) or red, and one diner found it lighter and less salty than expected, closer to Mokkosu than Hakata; it comes with about five slices of chashu and wood ear mushroom. Extra back fat is free, and so are pickled ginger, spicy takana, grated garlic, fried onion and mayonnaise. The Manpuku set pairs a bowl with a small char-rice. A chashu chuka soba (¥1,300) on thick noodles is the other option. Free half-size kaedama until 15:00 on weekdays. Buy tickets at the machine outside; cash or PayPay only.

chef_bio.background: Tonkotsu ramen shop, main store (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
chef_bio.philosophy: "A shop that seriously makes pork bone soup" (shop phrase quoted in an October 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Tonkotsu ramen in three styles; char-rice.

anecdotes.text: "The ramen is tonkotsu and you can choose from white, black, or red. I opted for the black with black garlic oil… The char rice, which is fried rice topped with an omelet, was incredibly tasty. The omelet was fluffy…" — September 2026, Manpuku set.
"The flavor was lighter and less salty than I expected, resembling more of a Mokkosu style than Hakata. I ordered extra fat, but it wasn't overwhelming…" — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: らーめん 極 本店、大阪市阿倍野区旭町1-1-26 ウエムラあべのビル 1F、天王寺駅から約5分、動物園前駅から約5分、毎日11:00〜22:00、定休日不定、カード・電子マネー不可、QRはPayPay可、カウンター9席。口コミ(2026年9〜10月): Char-rice で知られる豚骨ラーメンの本店、外の券売機、Manpuku Set (ラーメンと小さな Char-rice)、豚骨は Shiro、Kuro (黒にんにく油)、Aka の3種、背脂増し無料、きくらげ、チャーシュー約5枚、博多より Mokkosu に近いあっさりで塩気控えめ、平日15時まで半替え玉無料、卓上に黒胡椒、山椒、ごま、唐辛子とご飯用の3種のソース、無料トッピングに紅しょうが、辛子高菜、おろしにんにく、フライドオニオン、マヨネーズ、Char-rice はふわふわのオムレツをのせた薄味の炒めご飯、店員が親切、チャーシュー中華そば1,300円は太麺と味付きメンマ。

osaka_chuka_soba_tsuji_tenmabashi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles; soy-sauce soup; chili oil.
osaka_chuka_soba_tsuji_tenmabashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: meat broth; beef horumon; chashu; egg yolk and quail eggs.
osaka_chuka_soba_tsuji_tenmabashi.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–14:15 and 17:30–21:15; closed the evening of the third Tuesday each month; occasional temporary closures, check Google Maps (Tabelog). Check in on the touch panel out front, then buy a ticket inside (2026). Cards, IC cards, e-money and QR (incl. Alipay, WeChat Pay) accepted (Tabelog).
osaka_chuka_soba_tsuji_tenmabashi.notes: [Ramen · punchy chili-and-garlic chuka soba by Tenmabashi] An eleven-seat shop a minute from Tenmabashi, open since 2023 and now busy thanks to social media: check in on the touch panel out front and expect a wait (about 25 minutes to get in, one August lunch). The chuka soba is shoyu loaded with chili and fresh garlic; one diner calls this kind of punch rare in Kansai, where Mongolian Tanmen Nakamoto has no shops, while another found it a fairly standard shoyu with chili. The beef horumon chuka soba brings more chili and garlic, and one diner found the sour and spicy djanmen (¥1,800) rich to the last bite. Limited bowls rotate: Bachiro (¥1,100 with extra sprouts) on borrowed noodles, and a chilled tantan mazesoba in summer. Add a meat-taku rice bowl (¥550). Cards and QR accepted.

chef_bio.specialty: Spicy chuka soba with chili and garlic; limited bowls.

anecdotes.text: "The Chuka Soba here is known for its spiciness, featuring chili peppers as a highlight. I ordered the spicy Chuka Soba with beef offal in a large size." — August 2026; about 25 minutes in line to get inside.
"I added some garlic from the table and got ready to dig in. This chuka soba seemed like it was made just for someone like me, who loves garlic and chili." — October 2026, beef horumon chuka soba.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 中華そば 辻、大阪市中央区釣鐘町1-1-1、天満橋駅④出口から徒歩1分、毎日11:00〜14:15・17:30〜21:15、毎月第3火曜の夜は休み、臨時休業あり、カード・電子マネー・QR (Alipay、WeChat Pay を含む) 可、11席(カウンター7、2人掛けテーブル2)、2023年4月11日開店。口コミ(2026年5〜10月): 店前のタッチパネルで受付、店内で食券、SNSで人気になり行列、約25分で入店、唐辛子が主役の辛い中華そば、牛ホルモンの中華そば大盛り、関西では珍しいパンチ、Mongolian Tanmen Nakamoto との比較、限定のバチ郎 (もやし増し1,100円、別ブランドの麺、濃口醤油、たっぷりのチャーシュー)、バチ郎 うずら増し、バチ郎 ホルモン増し、龍のたまごのTKG、肉タク丼550円、バッチバチ牛ホル中華そば、夏の冷やし担々まぜそば (特製はうずら卵とキムチ)、特製酸辣ジャンメン1,800円、唐辛子と生にんにくの醤油ラーメンで普通だったという声、卵黄、卓上のにんにく、ストレートの細麺を出す Mokkosu を思い出したという声、豚の火入れや脂にばらつきがあったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Digital check-in out front, and staff came out to explain it (October 2026); ticket inside.

osaka_iekei_semba_ya_tsuruhashi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles; soy tare; doubanjiang on the table.
osaka_iekei_semba_ya_tsuruhashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork-bone and chicken broth; chicken oil; pork chashu; egg.
osaka_iekei_semba_ya_tsuruhashi.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); hours may change (Tabelog). Free rice (100 or 150 g) at lunch; no refills (2026). Buy tickets at the machine; state noodle firmness, flavor strength and oil when handing it over. Cards, IC cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog).
osaka_iekei_semba_ya_tsuruhashi.notes: [Ramen · lighter iekei with smoked chashu by Tsuruhashi] An eight-seat counter about ten minutes from Tsuruhashi, open since May 2025, with lines on weekends. The broth of pork bones and chicken carcasses is creamy and rich but easy to drink, with a mild soy tare and chicken oil, over chewy medium-thick short noodles from Inoue Seimen; order firmness, flavor and oil to taste. Smoked, oven-roasted thigh chashu (firm and meaty) and shredded chashu sit with komatsuna and nori. The jō ramen (¥1,000) adds chashu, nori and half an egg. Rice is free at lunch; top it with the pickled cucumber and furikake, and finish with doubanjiang from the table. One diner calls it possibly the best iekei in Osaka; another found the broth thinner and the chashu dry on a later visit. Staff see you off at the door.

chef_bio.specialty: Iekei ramen with smoked thigh chashu.

anecdotes.text: "The broth, made from simmered pork bones and chicken carcasses, has a rich umami flavor. It strikes a nice balance with a mild soy sauce taste, making it easy to drink… The noodles are medium-thick, short noodles from Inoue Seimen…" — September 2026, jō ramen ¥1,000.

"The noodles were thick and had a strong texture, giving a firm impression with less chewiness. The chashu was moist and tender, with a perfect contrast of smoky flavor and meaty goodness." — October 2026, firm noodles and extra oil.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 家系ラーメン 船場家、大阪市天王寺区味原町4-8、鶴橋から398m、毎日11:00〜15:00・17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、カード・電子マネー・QR可、カウンター8席、2025年5月31日開店。口コミ(2026年8〜10月): 豚骨と鶏ガラのスープ、マイルドな醤油、Inoue Seimen の中太の短い麺、燻製したオーブン焼きの豚もものチャーシューと刻みチャーシュー、小松菜、ねぎ、海苔、10月24・25日だけ豚バラのチャーシュー、チャーシューラーメン1,100円、Jō Ramen 1,000円 (チャーシュー1枚、海苔2枚、味玉半分を追加)、昼はライス100gか150gが無料、おかわりなし、ほうれん草に変更50円、刻み玉ねぎ100円、ライス200g 100円、卓上に豆板醤、にんにく、生姜、酢、ごま、ラーメンペッパー、きゅうりの漬物、ふりかけ、麺の硬さ・味の濃さ・油の量を選べる、明るく丁寧な接客、見送り、週末は行列、クリーミーで濃厚なスープ、Rokukaku-ya に似ているという声、大阪の家系で一番かもという声、2回目はスープが薄くチャーシューが乾いていたという声、券売機。

osaka_maren_higobashi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: thick wheat noodles; soy-based sauce.
osaka_maren_higobashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken sauces and paitan; chashu; seasoned egg; niboshi vinegar.
osaka_maren_higobashi.hours_raw: Daily 10:30–22:00 (Tabelog). Order on the touch panel; long lines after 12:00 at lunch (2026). Cards, IC cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog).
osaka_maren_higobashi.notes: [Ramen · tidy mazesoba with a rice finish at Higobashi] An eleven-seat shop right by Higobashi exit 9, open since April 2023 and part of MAREN, the mazesoba shop with a branch in Shinsaibashi. The shoyu mazesoba (¥980) coats thick, chewy noodles in a sauce that's rich but not heavy and arrives neatly arranged; add niboshi vinegar halfway, then mix the small scoop of rice into what's left. The chicken shio mazesoba gets its lift from shiso, and there's a chicken shoyu chashu version. The chicken paitan ramen is less loved: one diner saw it made from powders blended into a clear liquid on an IH burner. Order on the touch panel. Lines build after 12:00, so go early or late. Cards and QR accepted.

chef_bio.background: Mazesoba shop; sister shop of MAREN Shinsaibashi (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: "The thick noodles are coated in a flavorful sauce that's delicious! It's rich but not too heavy… I added some niboshi vinegar for a flavor change, which made it even smoother!" — October 2026, shoyu mazesoba.
"To finish off, you can mix in a small plate of rice, which is so tasty that I can't help but finish it all…" — September 2026, shoyu mazesoba ¥980.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: MAREN 肥後橋、大阪市西区江戸堀1-15-7、四つ橋線肥後橋駅9番出口から69m、毎日10:30〜22:00、カード・電子マネー・QR可、11席、2023年4月1日開店。口コミ(2026年8〜10月): 醤油まぜそば980円、太麺に濃厚だが重すぎないたれ、途中で煮干し酢、最後に小さなご飯を混ぜる、鶏塩まぜそば (ミニご飯付き) は大葉の風味ともちもちの麺、味玉150円、タッチパネルで注文、鶏醤油チャーシューまぜそばは見た目がおしゃれでマイルド、たれがたっぷり、12時を過ぎると行列、昼は時間をずらすのがおすすめ、グッズ、鶏白湯はIHの小鍋で透明な液体に粉を混ぜて作っていたという声、近くの Zagin が行列でこちらへという声。
